provenance.entitlement: Hosted OAuth quote:read scope; one entitled subscription read for HK.00700. Credentials remain with the host; no token is stored or forwarded here.
provenance.note: One real entitled $0 read.ticker captured through the hosted moomoo MCP OAuth binding (N3). The hosted quote_stock_quote descriptor is byte-identical to the reviewed Desktop pin (schema digest 5abc6284b856ea946ad158c96252c99e4d5c4ef3e7a65bb442d201f8b11399fb), so the reviewed read.ticker mapping binds it unchanged. Discovery descriptor metadata plus one business read; replay uses this fixture with zero extra provider calls. Prices are JSON numbers; the reviewed projection records their exact round-trip decimal string. Currency, delay class and per-quote feed attribution remain unknown.

tools.name: quote_stock_quote
tools.description: Batch get realtime stock quotes for the symbols (realtime quote, subscription required). Returns: stock symbol/name, data_time (ms exchange time), data_date (market timezone), last/open/high/low/previous-close prices, volume/turnover, turnover rate, amplitude, security status/suspension/dark-pool status, listing date; option_ex_data (strike/contract size/open interest/IV/premium/Delta/Gamma/Vega/Theta/Rho/net open interest/contract nominal value/owner lot multiplier/contract multiplier/index option type/expiry-date distance/American-European); future_ex_data (last settlement/position/position change); pre_market/after_market/overnight sub-objects. Leaner field set than quote.market_snapshot, better for multi-symbol polling.

code_list.description: Stock symbol list, format {market}.{code}, e.g. ["HK.00700", "US.AAPL"]; recommended ≤400 symbols per call; subscription required for each symbol
